About the network

LAFMAT – The Latin American Network of Condensed Matter Physics and Materials Science is a non-profit scientific community devoted to strengthening academic integration across Latin America and enhancing the international visibility of research produced in the region. The network promotes regular online seminars that connect Latin American researchers with leading scientists worldwide, fostering collaboration, scientific exchange, and the dissemination of cutting-edge advances in condensed matter physics and materials science .

With representatives from multiple Latin American countries and a collaborative organizational structure, LAFMAT serves as a dynamic platform for building research partnerships, encouraging the participation of early-career scientists, and consolidating regional scientific excellence on a global stage. Its scope includes topics such as magnetism, superconductivity, quantum materials, strongly correlated systems, semiconductors, nanomaterials, surfaces and interfaces, optics, and computational materials science .
